title: Viewbix Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-21
summary: Viewbix Inc., a Delaware corporation trading on Nasdaq Capital Market under ticker VBIX, announced a corporate name change to Quantum X Labs Inc. and ticker change to QXL, effective at market open on April 30, 2026. The CUSIP number remains unchanged and existing stock certificates remain valid.

Company is incorporated in Delaware with principal office in Ramat Gan, Israel.
